snippet.title: Parallax Solo Kill (Before Enrage Timer Patch) | Solar Colonies MMO Game
snippet.description: In Solar Colonies, you play as a volunteer serving the Confederation, which operates seven space stations orbiting different planets across the Solar System. Your mission is to defend these stations and fight off the constant alien raids threatening the system.
